verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that the ANEF portal serves a JavaScript shell with transactions behind an account, and that the parent ministry site returns a Cloudflare challenge. Nothing describes the sign-in method, so there is no evidence of credential MFA that an authorized human can complete remotely, nor of any biometric, in-person or mailed-PIN requirement. The axis applies to a government account portal, but delivery is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail
